question: 按商品所属类目统计全部订单明细金额（order_items.amount，不扣退款、不筛状态），返回类目ID、名称、金额。
gold_sql: SELECT c.id,c.name,SUM(i.amount) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id GROUP BY c.id,c.name

question: 按支付方式统计全部支付金额和对应订单的全部退款金额，不筛状态，无退款计0。退款先按订单汇总，避免多行退款放大支付金额。返回支付方式、支付金额、退款金额。
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount) amount FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) SELECT p.pay_method,SUM(p.amount),SUM(COALESCE(r.amount,0)) FROM payments p LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id=p.order_id GROUP BY p.pay_method

question: 找出订单至少3笔的客户，按全部订单明细金额降序取前20名，同额按客户ID升序；返回客户ID、订单数、明细金额。
gold_sql: SELECT o.customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),SUM(i.amount) total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)>=3 ORDER BY total DESC,o.customer_id LIMIT 20

question: 按月统计2026年的订单数，使用order_date，范围[2026-01-01,2027-01-01)，返回YYYY-MM月份、订单数，月份升序。
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7) month,COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date>='2026-01-01' AND order_date<'2027-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 有多少客户从未下单？返回客户数。
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id)

question: 按网点统计路由停留的平均小时数，仅取到达和离开均非NULL且离开不早于到达的记录，返回网点ID、平均小时数。

question: 按商户类别统计全部交易金额、笔数、平均每笔金额，不筛状态，返回类别、金额、笔数、平均金额。

question: 按客户分层统计账户余额合计和卡数量，保留无账户客户，无余额计0，每个账户余额只累计一次；返回客户分层、余额、卡数量。
gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(balance) balance FROM accounts GROUP BY customer_id),k AS (SELECT a.customer_id,COUNT(*) n FROM cards k JOIN accounts a ON a.id=k.account_id GROUP BY a.customer_id) SELECT c.segment,SUM(COALESCE(a.balance,0)),SUM(COALESCE(k.n,0)) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON a.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN k ON k.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.segment

gold_sql: SELECT a.branch_id,b.branch_id,SUM(t.amount) FROM transfers t JOIN accounts a ON a.id=t.from_account_id JOIN accounts b ON b.id=t.to_account_id GROUP BY a.branch_id,b.branch_id ORDER BY a.branch_id,b.branch_id LIMIT 100

question: 按课程统计考试成绩记录的平均分、最高分，每条成绩等权，返回课程ID、名称、平均分、最高分。 结果按返回的ID列升序，只取前100行。

question: 按班级统计学习进度记录数和已完成记录占比，completed=1算完成，占比用0到1小数，返回班级ID、记录数、占比。 结果按返回的ID列升序，只取前100行。

question: 每场考试取最高分前3条成绩，同分按学生ID升序，用ROW_NUMBER选至多3条；返回考试ID、学生ID、分数、名次，按考试ID、名次升序，总共只取前100行。

question: 按产品计算BOM标准材料成本，SUM(bom.qty * materials.standard_price)，忽略损耗率，仅含有BOM的产品，返回产品ID、名称、材料成本。 结果按返回的ID列升序，只取前100行。
gold_sql: SELECT p.id,p.name,SUM(b.qty*m.standard_price) FROM products p JOIN bom b ON b.product_id=p.id JOIN materials m ON m.id=b.material_id GROUP BY p.id,p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 100

question: 查跨全部仓库库存合计低于安全库存的物料，无库存计0，按物料ID升序取前100条；返回物料ID、名称、库存合计、安全库存。
gold_sql: SELECT m.id,m.name,COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0),m.safety_stock FROM materials m LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.material_id=m.id GROUP BY m.id,m.name,m.safety_stock HAVING COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0)<m.safety_stock ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 100

question: 按车间统计工序计划分钟合计、实际分钟合计、实际与计划的比值，计划合计0时比值NULL，返回车间、计划、实际、比值。
gold_sql: SELECT m.workshop,SUM(o.planned_min),SUM(o.actual_min),1.0*SUM(o.actual_min)/NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_min),0) FROM operations o JOIN machines m ON m.id=o.machine_id GROUP BY m.workshop

question: 按质检结果统计检查记录数和缺陷数量合计，返回结果、记录数、缺陷数量。
gold_sql: SELECT result,COUNT(*),SUM(defect_qty) FROM quality_checks GROUP BY result

question: 按供应商等级统计全部采购明细金额，不筛状态，返回供应商等级、金额。
gold_sql: SELECT s.supplier_level,SUM(i.amount) FROM suppliers s JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.supplier_id=s.id JOIN po_items i ON i.po_id=p.id GROUP BY s.supplier_level

question: 按产品计算BOM标准材料成本，SUM(bom.qty * materials.standard_price)，忽略损耗率，仅含有BOM的产品，返回产品ID、名称、材料成本。 结果按返回的ID列升序，只取前100行。
gold_sql: SELECT p.id,p.name,SUM(b.qty*m.standard_price) FROM products p JOIN bom b ON b.product_id=p.id JOIN materials m ON m.id=b.material_id GROUP BY p.id,p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 100

question: 查跨全部仓库库存合计低于安全库存的物料，无库存计0，按物料ID升序取前100条；返回物料ID、名称、库存合计、安全库存。
gold_sql: SELECT m.id,m.name,COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0),m.safety_stock FROM materials m LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.material_id=m.id GROUP BY m.id,m.name,m.safety_stock HAVING COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0)<m.safety_stock ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 100

question: 按车间统计工序计划分钟合计、实际分钟合计、实际与计划的比值，计划合计0时比值NULL，返回车间、计划、实际、比值。
gold_sql: SELECT m.workshop,SUM(o.planned_min),SUM(o.actual_min),1.0*SUM(o.actual_min)/NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_min),0) FROM operations o JOIN machines m ON m.id=o.machine_id GROUP BY m.workshop

question: 按质检结果统计检查记录数和缺陷数量合计，返回结果、记录数、缺陷数量。
gold_sql: SELECT result,COUNT(*),SUM(defect_qty) FROM quality_checks GROUP BY result

question: 按区域统计f_sales金额合计和记录数，返回区域ID、名称、金额、记录数。 按区域ID升序取前100行。
gold_sql: SELECT d.id,d.name,SUM(f.amount),COUNT(*) FROM f_sales f JOIN d_region d ON d.id=f.region_id GROUP BY d.id,d.name ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 100

question: 按渠道统计f_orders数量和金额合计，返回渠道ID、名称、数量、金额。 按渠道ID升序取前100行。
gold_sql: SELECT d.id,d.name,SUM(f.qty),SUM(f.amount) FROM f_orders f JOIN d_channel d ON d.id=f.channel_id GROUP BY d.id,d.name ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 100

question: 按区域统计t_121的metric_value合计，返回区域ID、名称、合计。
gold_sql: SELECT d.id,d.name,SUM(t.metric_value) FROM t_121 t JOIN d_region d ON d.id=t.region_id GROUP BY d.id,d.name

question: f_sales和t_001先各自按区域汇总，保留全部区域，无数据计0，返回区域ID、销售金额合计、t_001指标合计。 按区域ID升序取前100行。
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT region_id,SUM(amount) v FROM f_sales GROUP BY region_id),t AS (SELECT region_id,SUM(metric_value) v FROM t_001 GROUP BY region_id) SELECT d.id,COALESCE(f.v,0),COALESCE(t.v,0) FROM d_region d LEFT JOIN f ON f.region_id=d.id LEFT JOIN t ON t.region_id=d.id ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 100

question: 订单总数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order

question: 销售额是多少？按GMV口径汇总全部订单实付金额，包含退款状态。
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amount) FROM fact_order

question: 客单价是多少？对全部订单的实付金额求平均，包含退款状态。
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(pay_amount) FROM fact_order

question: 已退款订单有多少笔？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order WHERE status='refunded'

question: 2026年10月订单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order WHERE order_date>='2026-10-01' AND order_date<'2026-11-01'

question: 按渠道统计全部订单实付金额，返回渠道、金额。
gold_sql: SELECT channel,SUM(pay_amount) FROM fact_order GROUP BY channel

question: 各渠道实付金额占全部实付金额的比例是多少？返回渠道、0到1小数占比。
gold_sql: SELECT channel,SUM(pay_amount)/(SELECT SUM(pay_amount) FROM fact_order) FROM fact_order GROUP BY channel

question: 列出单价最高前5个商品，单价降序、同价按product_id升序，返回product_id、product、unit_price。
gold_sql: SELECT product_id,product,unit_price FROM dim_product ORDER BY unit_price DESC,product_id LIMIT 5

question: 按所属大区汇总全部订单实付金额，通过渠道名称关联，返回大区、金额。
gold_sql: SELECT c.region,SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel=o.channel GROUP BY c.region

question: 查2099年1月订单，只返回order_id、order_date，订单ID升序；没有就返回空结果，保持日期条件。
gold_sql: SELECT order_id,order_date FROM fact_order WHERE order_date>='2099-01-01' AND order_date<'2099-02-01' ORDER BY order_id

question: 2099年1月实付金额合计是多少？无记录时返回NULL，不改成0。
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE order_date>='2099-01-01' AND order_date<'2099-02-01'

question: 列出商品表所有不同品类，返回品类一列，去除重复。
